description:
WRITE (testnet) - launches a new token on GIWA Sepolia (chain 91342) through the Ammora SDK. The token starts on an Ammora bonding curve priced in WETH; anyone can buy or sell it there (q402_token_trade) until it raises the Config's graduation threshold and moves to a pool. Optionally makes the first buy in the same call (firstBuyEth). The launching wallet is the token's creator and earns the Config's creator share of trading fees. Signed by the local GIWA signer key (Q402_GIWA_PRIVATE_KEY); gas is GIWA Sepolia faucet ETH, no real funds. 

REQUIRES CONFIRMATION - call FIRST without confirm to get a preview and a consentToken, show it to the user, then re-call with sandbox:false, confirm:true AND the consentToken.

confirm.description: Must be true for a real launch.

description.description: Optional one-line description for the token metadata.

firstBuyEth.description: Optional first buy in ETH right after launch, e.g. '0.0005'.

name: q402_token_launch
